subject: Renewal amendment: add GPUs and clarify throughput SLA - CloudMetrics
messages:
From: Amit Shah <amit.shah@cloudmetrics.com>
To: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com
Cc: Emily Tran <emily.tran@cloudmetrics.com>, procurement@cloudmetrics.com
Date: Tue, 10 Jul 2028 09:32:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal amendment: mid-contract add of 16 GPUs / SLA clarification

Hi Stephanie,

We're reviewing our Dedicated pool renewal and have a short-notice request from our models team: can we add 16 A100-equivalent GPUs to our existing pool mid-contract? The ask is to (1) confirm available capacity on your side for an August 1 start, (2) provide incremental pricing for the remainder of our term (11 months), and (3) clarify throughput guarantees if we increase pool size (we need 150 tokens/sec sustained for our 512-token average).

Also, procurement asked whether there is a consolidated amendment you can send (pricing + SLA appendix) so we can fast-track internal approvals. If there are any volume/commit discounts for adding now vs waiting for renewal, please include those options.

FWIW our legal has tight standard terms; we expect to use your standard amendment template with minimal redlines.

Can you confirm availability and an estimated quote by EOD Thursday? We have a billing review on Friday that would prefer to include this.

Thanks,
Amit Shah
Head of Infrastructure, CloudMetrics
amit.shah@cloudmetrics.com

From: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com
To: Amit Shah <amit.shah@cloudmetrics.com>
Cc: Emily Tran <emily.tran@cloudmetrics.com>, procurement@cloudmetrics.com
Date: Tue, 10 Jul 2028 12:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal amendment: mid-contract add of 16 GPUs / SLA clarification

Hi Amit — thanks for the clear ask. Quick answers up front:
- Availability: we can provision the additional 16 A100-equivalent GPUs to start 2028-08-01 in our us-west cluster.
- Quote: I'll send two pricing paths — (A) pro-rated add-on for the remaining 11 months, and (B) a blended early-renew + top-up bundle with a modest step discount.
- Throughput SLA: we can commit to 150 tokens/sec sustained per your workload profile, provided the pool is sized and we agree on request shaping (concurrency limits + batching hints). I'll include an SLA appendix with the required workload assumptions and an escalation path.

I'm attaching a draft amendment (CM_Dedicated_Amendment_v1.pdf) and a short throughput chart from our benchmarking run for your 512-token distribution. Notes are inline in the amendment about throughput preconditions.

If you want, we can lock a 5% one-time add discount for mid-contract additions that sign before 2028-07-22; otherwise standard pro-rate applies.

Will follow up with internal pricing/approval and a final quote by Thursday EOD.

Best,
Stephanie Nguyen
Senior Account Executive — Dedicated Capacity
Redwood Inference
stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0148

Attachments: CM_Dedicated_Amendment_v1.pdf (draft amendment), throughput-benchmark-chart.png

From: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com
To: rishi_malhotra@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 11 Jul 2028 09:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Renewal amendment: mid-contract add of 16 GPUs / SLA clarification

Rishi / Karthik — forwarding CloudMetrics request. Key points: 16 A100-eq added 2028-08-01, remaining term 11 months, need throughput SLA 150 tokens/sec sustained for 512-token median. Procurement wants an amendment and any add-now discount.

Proposed commercial options to validate:
1) Pro-rate add-on: list price * 11/12, no discount (fast),
2) Blended early renew + top-up: 10% discount on new capacity if they convert to a 12-month renewal today (requires approval),
3) One-time concession: 5% add discount if signed by 2028-07-22 (sales-enabled).

Can you advise which path we can approve in the field vs what needs sales leadership sign-off? Also need confirmation that SLA appendix language is standard (I'll attach).

Thanks — Steph

From: rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
To: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 12 Jul 2028 14:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Renewal amendment: mid-contract add of 16 GPUs / SLA clarification

Steph — thanks for routing. I think we should keep flexibility for the account exec but protect margin. Approvals:
- Option 1 (pro-rate) — ok for SE (no discount).
- Option 3 (5% add discount if sign by 7/22) — OK for you to offer up to 5% discount, no additional approvals. Communicate as one-time promotional concession.
- Option 2 (10% blended early renewal) — requires pipeline review + quota impact sign-off from Sales Ops + a 2% back-end rebate handled by finance; escalate to me for final.

SLA wording: keep the workload preconditions and an automatic fallback clause (if token/sec drops below 140 sustained for >10 minutes we initiate capacity rebalancing; credits only if we fail to meet rebalance SLA). Use standard appendix and we can provide a short engineering addendum.

I'll sign off on the 5% option and the standard SLA appendix. If they push for 10% we open a deal thread and I will route.

-Rishi
VP, Renewals & Strategic Accounts
rishi_malhotra@redwood.com

From: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com
To: Amit Shah <amit.shah@cloudmetrics.com>
Cc: Emily Tran <emily.tran@cloudmetrics.com>, procurement@cloudmetrics.com, rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 18 Jul 2028 16:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal amendment: mid-contract add of 16 GPUs / SLA clarification

Amit — quick summary and next steps. Thanks for the patience while we pulled internal approvals.

1) Availability: We can place 16 A100-equivalent GPUs into your Dedicated pool with start date 2028-08-01 (us-west).
2) Pricing options (attached amendment v1):
   - Pro-rate add-on (fast): list rate for 16 GPUs pro-rated for 11 months — estimated incremental monthly = $42,000; total incremental term = $462,000.
   - Early-renew + top-up (blend): 12-month renewal today + add capacity; blended price gives ~10% effective discount across committed capacity. This requires a formal renewal amendment and Sales Ops review.
   - Time-limited concession: 5% one-time discount on the incremental add if signed by 2028-07-22 (we can still accept signature after that but at list).
3) SLA: Attached appendix clarifies throughput obligations. We will commit to 150 tokens/sec sustained assuming the request shaping and concurrency guidance in section 2. If sustained throughput falls below 140 tokens/sec for more than 10 minutes due to our service-side issue, we will initiate rebalancing and credit per the appendix.

Attachments: CM_Dedicated_Amendment_v1.pdf, throughput-benchmark-chart.png

Requested next steps:
- Please confirm which pricing path you prefer (Pro-rate vs Blend vs 5% sign-by concession) by EOB Monday 2028-07-22 so we can reserve capacity and apply the concession.
- If you want the blended renewal path, flag and I will open a Sales Ops thread and route for the 10% structured discount.

If it helps, Emily and I can do a 30-min call Friday to walk the SLA appendix with your infra team.

Best regards,
Stephanie Nguyen
Senior Account Executive — Dedicated Capacity
Redwood Inference
stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0148
